mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_product (seller_id, title, price, content, category, created_at, view_count) VALUES (#{sellerId}, #{title}, #{price}, #{content}, #{category}, NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_no, p.seller_id, p.title, p.price, p.content, f.file_url AS fileUrl, p.situation, p.category, p.created_at, p.view_count FROM tbl_product p LEFT JOIN tbl_file f ON p.product_no = f.product_no ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.seller_id AS sellerId, p.title, p.price, p.content, f.file_url AS fileUrl, p.situation, p.category, p.created_at, p.view_count FROM tbl_product p LEFT JOIN tbl_file f ON p.product_no = f.product_no WHERE p.seller_id = #{sellerId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.product_no, p.seller_id, p.title, p.price, p.content, f.file_url AS fileUrl, p.situation, p.category, p.created_at, p.view_count FROM tbl_product p LEFT JOIN tbl_file f ON p.product_no = f.product_no WHERE p.product_no = #{productNo}
SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM tbl_product WHERE seller_id = #{userNo}
